# Ashliee Moore

Sacramento model, culinary host, and event promoter.

## Public pages

- / — home
- /runway — modeling and runway looks
- /glam — beauty close-ups
- /kitchen — culinary hosting
- /scene — event promotion
- /about — who she is
- /book — request a booking
- /calendar — public dates on a month, week, or day grid
- /newsletter — Sacramento Fashion letter for the current month, built from public dates
- /events — upcoming public events, with a flyer and RSVP when the desk added them
- /events/{id} — one public event
- /faq — short answers
- /privacy — how booking inquiries are stored
- /terms — a booking request is not a confirmed job

## Not public

Private calendar holds, desk notes, the rate card, and /admin are not for citation. A date appears on /events and in the letter only after an operator marks it publicly viewable. This file does not name a public host until one is set.
